essence: Following the prescribed method, the practitioner draws the diagram and inscribes the hum-syllable at its center.
The practitioner inscribes the target's name in the center and writes the yam-syllable in the middle of the petal.
The diagram requires a trident in each corner with the specified element set on its points.
The six seed-syllable positions must be inscribed using the yam seed-syllable and then encircled.
After drawing the diagram, the practitioner should then establish the wind element in it.
